story.title: Nvidia, Microsoft, Meta warn against overregulating open-weight models

draft:
I'm concerned that overregulating open-weight models could stifle AI innovation. 
Nvidia, Microsoft, and Meta are warning against this, citing potential barriers to progress. 
Key issues include limited access to models and increased costs. 
Will regulation strike the right balance between safety and innovation?
#AI #OpenWeightModels #Regulation
